name: client-proposal
description: Write a consulting engagement proposal. Use when a consultant says "write me a proposal", "draft a proposal for [your client]", "I need to send a proposal", "how do I structure a proposal", "client wants a SOW", "write a statement of work", "I need to propose a project", or "help me price and scope this engagement". Also trigger when someone describes a client conversation that ended with "send me something in writing".
